title: elsholtzia pilosa
intro: Elsholtzia pilosa, commonly known as Mountain Mint or Thai Mountain Mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which can help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Elsholtzia pilosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, such as genkwanin and pilosin, that exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-oxidative properties. By incorporating Elsholtzia pilosa into traditional medicine, it has shown potential in supporting overall health and well-being.
